meta.name: PETG
meta.description: PETG — the LMCAD drive/ball default filament. Mechanical block is the exact elastic input the CYCLO-26 drive FEA was validated against (E 2.0 GPa, nu 0.37, rho 1270), with the drive's 0.6 design derate reproducing the 28.2 MPa von Mises gate basis. Non-drive fields (ultimate, creep, fatigue, layer adhesion, service temp, heat-set pull-out) migrated from material_db.json and joint_check.py.

sn_curve.note: engineering rule of thumb (~1e6-cycle allowable = ultimate x 0.3), NOT a measured S-N curve

anisotropy.model: scalar-tier direction heuristic (production_check.py): across-layer (Z) tensile strength / in-plane (XY) strength; applied when the primary load is > threshold deg out of the layer plane

heatset_pullout_n.note: brass knurled heat-set at standard insert length (M3 5.7, M4 8.1, M5 9.5 mm); conservative low ends

design_derate.note: drive von Mises gate basis: allowable = yield 47 x 0.6 = 28.2 MPa (cyclo26/v2/analytics.py ALLOW_PETG). A FLAT design derate, distinct from the 0.70 anisotropy ratio.

sources.physical.density_kg_m3: cyclo26/v2/make_fea_jobs.py MAT + cyclo26/v2/fea_output_hub6/fea_job.json (drive FEA input) == material_db.json PETG.density_kg_m3 (all three agree at 1270)
sources.mechanical.youngs_modulus_pa: cyclo26/v2/make_fea_jobs.py MAT = 2.0e9 (drive FEA elastic input; conservative low end of the PETG 1.5-2.1 GPa datasheet band)
sources.mechanical.yield_mpa: cyclo26/v2/analytics.py ALLOW_PETG basis 28.2 MPa = 47 x 0.6 -> yield 47 MPa (conservative low end of Prusament/Ultimaker PETG tensile 47-50 MPa)
sources.mechanical.sn_curve: material_db.json PETG.fatigue_knockdown 0.3 (engineering rule of thumb, not a measured curve)
sources.thermal.tg_or_melt_c: typical PETG glass transition ~80 C (literature); no current analyzer consumes it
sources.thermal.conductivity_w_mk: typical PETG ~0.2 W/mK (literature); no current analyzer consumes it
sources.thermal.specific_heat_j_kgk: typical PETG ~1200 J/kgK (literature); no current analyzer consumes it
sources.thermal.cte_per_k: typical PETG linear CTE ~68e-6 /K (literature); no current analyzer consumes it
sources.process.heatset_pullout_n: joint_check.py HEATSET_PULLOUT_N[size][petg] (CNC Kitchen pull-out tests, conservative low ends)
sources.process.design_derate.gate_factor: cyclo26/v2/analytics.py ALLOW_PETG = 28.2e6 = yield 47 x 0.6 (drive gate basis)
sources.fluid.surface_roughness_um: typical FDM as-printed Ra at 0.2 mm layers (~12 um); layer-height dominated, not a polymer constant
sources.thermal.softening_c: softening_c = conservative softening allowable for sustained-load design: the LOW end of min(Tg, HDT-B 0.45 MPa) across cited brand TDS values for this material class (degC). PETG: 68 C = Prusament PETG TDS HDT 0.45 MPa ISO 75 https://www.prusa3d.com/file/2765253/prusament-petg-technical-data-sheet.pdf ; Bambu PETG Basic 69 C; Polymaker PolyLite PETG 78 C ISO 75 https://wiki.polymaker.com/polymaker-products/more-about-our-products/documents/technical-data-sheets/petg-pet/polylite-tm-petg
sources.thermal.conductivity_w_mk (2026-07-30 ve: record 0.2 kept — it is the safe FLOOR of the published band: MakeItFrom PETG 0.29 https://www.makeitfrom.com/material-properties/Glycol-Modified-Polyethylene-Terephthalate-PETG-PET-G (divbyz repeats it — one lineage); generic PET 0.15-0.4 @23 C (Professional Plastics chart), 0.25-0.30 (Kruse). No direct printed-neat-PETG measurement found (primary paywalled: https://4spepublications.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/pen.26409)
sources.thermal.tg_or_melt_c (2026-07-30 verific: record 80 confirmed: Polymaker PolyLite PETG TDS Tg 81 C DSC (URL above); measured 81.7 C, Bedi et al. (Wiley, PETG-graphene, search snippet); guides quote 75-85

conflicts.note: drive FEA uses 2.0e9; material_db uses 2.1e9. ~5% drift, both inside the 1.5-2.1 GPa datasheet band. Canonical = the value the shipped CYCLO-26 design was actually FEA-validated against.

conflicts.other_source: tools/material_db.json PETG.yield_mpa (read by production_check.py; its pinned selftest asserts creep allowable 50*0.25=12.5 MPa)
conflicts.note: drive gate uses 47 (-> 28.2 derated); production_check uses 50. Reconciling would change production_check's pinned PETG selftest allowables (creep 12.5->11.75, anisotropy 35->32.9) — a human physics decision, DEFERRED and not changed here.

the drive applies a FLAT 0.6 design derate always (yield 47 -> 28.2 MPa); production_check applies the 0.70 layer-adhesion ratio ONLY for loads > 30 deg out of the layer plane. Two different derate policies, both retained; surfaced so they are not conflated as one number.

conflicts.other_source: Prusament PETG TDS HDT 0.45 MPa = 68 C https://www.prusa3d.com/file/2765253/prusament-petg-technical-data-sheet.pdf
conflicts.note: material_db's service 75 C sits ABOVE Prusament's measured HDT-B (68 C). New thermal.softening_c carries the conservative 68; reconciling service_temp_c downward is a human allowable change — surfaced, not silently done.
